episodes.synopsis: Regent, Mohawk and Kohai get new digs in time for a new season. Time to take the delinquency up a notch!
episodes.title: Delinquent Hamsters

episodes.synopsis: Why does the hamsters’ new place smell weird? It rubs them the wrong way, that’s for sure. Looks like they gotta set things right…
episodes.title: Turf-Rubbing

episodes.synopsis: Time for open house tours! How do delinquent hamsters decorate? Let’s find out.
episodes.title: Open House

episodes.synopsis: The hamsters have new digs, but do they need a new character to really make this feel like Season 2? The delinquents discuss.
episodes.title: New Character Debate

episodes.synopsis: Gramps and Grams pay the delinquents a visit, and the delinquents have a LOT of questions. Perhaps too many to fit in just one episode…
episodes.title: Who's "Honey?" - Part 1

episodes.synopsis: Time to get to know Grams! She’s quite the inspiring hamster.
episodes.title: Who's "Honey?" - Part 2

episodes.synopsis: Are the hams forgetting something? Maybe Namippo? Or someone else? No, no, there’s no way…
episodes.title: Where's Namippo?

episodes.synopsis: How are the hams supposed to use a sofa, anyway? They should definitely start by claiming a spot, that’s for sure.
episodes.title: Sofa Discourse

episodes.synopsis: No more escaping, huh? Time for the hams to take up a new coping mechanism.
episodes.title: Drink Addicts

episodes.synopsis: Samurai hamster Kiyomasa is still looking for a sword. Perhaps the delinquents can help him find his destined blade.
episodes.title: Our Own Excalibur

episodes.synopsis: Kohai’s perm has gone haywire! Time to take drastic measures to tame the beast.
episodes.title: Humid Madness

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents set their sights on a delicious looking book, but they’ll have to be sneaky to claim their prize.
episodes.title: The Runaways

episodes.synopsis: The cushion strikes again and drains the hamsters of their usual rebellious energy. What would it take for them to break free from its dastardly clutches?
episodes.title: Cushion Lazing

episodes.synopsis: Gramps stops by to play a game of tag… but wait. What’s his real name again? Does Gramps even remember?
episodes.title: His Name

episodes.synopsis: Every good delinquent needs a war story or two. Kohai’s may just outshine them all. Time to get the dirt!
episodes.title: Kohai's Tale

episodes.synopsis: When the cat’s away, the mice will play… or the hamsters will play, in this case. Same difference.
episodes.title: Shimazu & Kato's Epic Struggle

episodes.synopsis: Whoever finds the coolest spot on the sofa is the boss… too bad no one can decide where that spot actually is.
episodes.title: Summer Sofa

episodes.synopsis: Should the hams chill out on the cursing? How does one become a better delinquent, anyhow? The hamsters discuss.
episodes.title: Polite Fighting

episodes.synopsis: Rugby is pretty cool. Do the hamsters even know the rules? Eh, whatever. It’ll be fine…
episodes.title: Heated Tries

episodes.synopsis: There’s a new bird in town and Namippo isn’t happy about it.
episodes.title: Jealousy

episodes.synopsis: Are the hamsters actually night owls? Real delinquents don’t take naps!
episodes.title: Fighting off Sleep

episodes.synopsis: Regents wants to learn to whistle. Can Mohawk and Kohai teach him how?
episodes.title: Whistling Wish

episodes.synopsis: Kinkuma needs to go big or go home if he wants to pass his art class, but it’s hard for him to draw things he doesn’t care about. Maybe he should draw his hams!
episodes.title: Kinkuma's Challenge

episodes.synopsis: There’s an interloper in the hams’ midst, and it really gets their gourd.
episodes.title: Bro-o-lantern

episodes.synopsis: Kohai is thinking of becoming a “mild” delinquent. Whatever that’s supposed to mean.
episodes.title: Mild Delinquency

episodes.synopsis: Twee-Phoenix has an impressive name. Do they live up to it? Is it even their name? This is confusing…
episodes.title: Phoenix

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk falls for fall. Or he would, if it would actually get here... This conversation sure is taking a while…
episodes.title: Fall Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk’s tissues are missing. Regent helps find them. He is an ace detective, you see.
episodes.title: Detective Regent

episodes.synopsis: The beacons are lit! Kiyomasa calls for aid!
episodes.title: Perfect Meditation

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk and Regent have been robbed! There’s only one possible culprit… isn’t there? An investigation has begun!
episodes.title: Missing Snacks

episodes.synopsis: The birds seem to be friendly all of a sudden… or does their cheerful mood conceal a darker truth? Dun dun DUN!
episodes.title: Rivals on the Balcony

episodes.synopsis: Tensions are running high amongst the hams, but that’s nothing a little Chris Moose cheer can’t fix.
episodes.title: The Christmas Ultra-nice List

episodes.synopsis: Grams and Gramps reminisce. They remember a lot from over the years, but will they remember they have an audience?
episodes.title: Old Ham Memories

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents need fancy finishing moves to use the next time they get in a fight. Time to brainstorm!
episodes.title: Secret Move Conference

episodes.synopsis: Kohai takes a nap and has a really strange dream. Like… it’s weird as heck, y’all. What is even happening!?
episodes.title: Visual Novel Delinquents

episodes.synopsis: All Regent wants is a little PEACE and QUIET! Too bad he lives with such rowdy hams… maybe he can calm them down a little?
episodes.title: Yoga Time

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk finally has someone he can whistle with! Time to relax and enjoy the song.
episodes.title: Whistling Concert

episodes.synopsis: The hams wax poetic on the subject of fruit, but which ones are their favs? The hams debate!
episodes.title: Mouth-off Training

episodes.synopsis: Kohai tries to improve his nonverbal communication skills, much to the other hams’ confusion.
episodes.title: A Telling Look

episodes.synopsis: The Bro-o-Lantern returns! That means Halloween is almost here. Time for a costume competition to celebrate the spookiest of seasons!
episodes.title: Halloween Battle

episodes.synopsis: Regent wants to hold a press conference, but what the heck are press conferences even for, anyway?
episodes.title: Quotes for the Press

episodes.synopsis: Merry Chris Moose! The hams present their presents to one another and celebrate another year together.
episodes.title: Present Presenting

episodes.synopsis: Welcome to Delinquent Lingo 101 with your instructor, Kohai the delinquent hamster!
episodes.title: Delinquent Lingo 101

episodes.synopsis: The A/C doesn’t seem to be working properly, and the hams are feeling the heat… or the lack of it, to be specific. Why is it so COLD!?
episodes.title: Winter Training

episodes.synopsis: The Grand-1 Grand Prix is underway, and the hams are off to the races to prove they’re the ultimate grandkid!
episodes.title: Grand-1 Grand Prix

episodes.synopsis: Regent and Mohawk take their playtime very seriously, so while they goof off, Kohai will take some time for selfcare.
episodes.title: Hold Up Kohai

episodes.synopsis: The delinquent hams teach Kiyomasa the fine art of doing nothing at all.
episodes.title: Lazy Techniques

episodes.synopsis: The siren song of fame is calling, but what will the delinquent hamsters have to do to become stars? Does Smartphone Bro hold the answers?
episodes.title: Worldwide Delinquents

episodes.synopsis: A fight erupts… kind of. The hams are voice training and it’s confusing for Kohai. Hopefully they don’t yell too loudly and destroy their throats.
episodes.title: Voice Training

episodes.synopsis: Life has been pretty lowkey lately, so Regent wants a new rival. But where the heck can a ham get a new rival on short notice?
episodes.title: Looking for Rivals
